name: Xia Yizhou
source:
"What, you don't recognize me?"
"Did you honestly think I would always be the kindhearted boy in your childhood?"

Protagonist's non-blood-related brother. Their grandma Josephine took both of them when they were young. He works as a fighter pilot for the Deepspace Aviation Administration. Ever since he went to Aerospace Academy in Skyhaven, they don't see each other often but always pay visit Grandma during Holidays. Has a teasing nature while also being reliable big brother for the protagonist.

The mysterious explosions and the sudden return of the Farspace Fleet... Set out for Skyhaven City to uncover the truth behind the shrouded mystery.


[Taken from [URL=https://twitter.com/Love_Deepspace/status/1722090003508174974/]Official Twitter account[/URL]]
